prince-george.title: Prince George, B.C., to launch review into accessibility of cremation services
prince-george.description: The City of Prince George will launch a review into the accessibility of cremation services in the north-central B.C. community, after reports of families travelling to neighbouring communities to access services.

all.title: VIFF film Send the Rain explores Okinawan Canadian experience, set against the backdrop of wildfires
all.description: As wildfire closes in on her family’s farm, a young Okinawan Canadian journeys from the big city to rural B.C., to try to get her Oba — or grandmother — to evacuate. Erika, portrayed by Erika Prevost, wants her Oba with her in the city — but Oba believes Erika needs the farm.
